subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: Should gateway projections omit avatars above the inline budget, or must they preserve visible avatars through thumbnailing or a lazy reference?
rationale: The PR fixes an availability bug by intentionally removing avatarUrl for existing accepted avatars, while the canonical issue also proposes thumbnail or reference delivery; code review cannot choose that user-facing compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Omit oversized projections
options.body: Keep the 2 MB accepted source, omit every inline representation above a consistently enforced projection budget, and provide identifiable warnings plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Thumbnail projected avatars
options.body: Re-encode oversized sources into a small visual thumbnail so existing avatar visibility is preserved at greater implementation and dependency complexity.

options.title: Use lazy avatar references
options.body: Change gateway/client behavior to return a fetchable reference instead of inline bytes, requiring coordinated protocol and client work.

recommendation.title: Omit oversized projections
recommendation.body: Keep the 2 MB accepted source, omit every inline representation above a consistently enforced projection budget, and provide identifiable warnings plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent avatar projection split and the shared size-hardening contract that this decision changes.
